zhText: 一顿再普通不过的午饭后，你的肚脐周围，突然开始隐隐作痛，甚至泛起恶心，连吐了两次。
enText: After an ordinary lunch, a dull ache starts around your navel, bringing nausea and two bouts of vomiting.

zhText: 这会儿炎症还藏在阑尾内层，疼痛借着内脏神经往外传，定位含糊不清，像在和你捉迷藏。
enText: Inflammation is still tucked inside the inner wall; visceral nerves carry vague signals, playing hide-and-seek.

zhText: 可窗外的太阳落下去、弯月升起来，傍晚六点，这股疼突然“搬了家”，死死钉在了右下腹的麦氏点——一按就痛，松手更痛。
enText: As the sun sets and the moon rises at 6 PM, the pain suddenly migrates to McBurney's point—tender to press, worse on release.

zhText: 熬到晚上十点急诊入院，体温飙到三十九点三度，白细胞和中性粒细胞全线拉响警报。
enText: By 10 PM in the ER, your fever hits 39.3°C, while white blood cells and neutrophils sound full alarm.

zhText: 短短十个小时，腹腔深处那根原本粉白细长的“小香肠”，正经历一场触目惊心的变色日记：从粉、到红、到黄、甚至发黑。
enText: In just ten hours, that pale-pink "little sausage" undergoes a dramatic color diary: from pink, to red, to yellow, even black.

zhText: 平时藏在盲肠盲端的阑尾，只是一根粉白细长、柔软安静的小盲管，和你的小指差不多粗细。
enText: Usually tucked beneath the cecum, the appendix is a pale-pink, slender blind tube about the width of your pinky.

zhText: 可急诊手术台取出的这一根，早就变了模样：它肿胀增粗、通体暗红，浆膜上的血管像愤怒的蛛网一样剧烈扩张充血。
enText: Yet the resected one is transformed: swollen and dark red, with serosal vessels fiercely engorged like angry webs.

zhText: 把镜头再推近一点，暗红表面还裹着一层醒目的灰黄色脓苔——这正是急性化脓性，也就是蜂窝织炎性阑尾炎的标志。
enText: Zooming closer, a striking grayish-yellow purulent coat wraps the dark-red wall—the hallmark of acute phlegmonous appendicitis.

zhText: 沿着虚线轻轻切开，狭小的管腔里早已灌满黄红色脓液，有时还能找到堵死出口的粪石。让我们钻进显微镜，看看微观世界发生了什么。
enText: Slicing along the dotted line reveals yellow-red pus filling the lumen, sometimes with an obstructing fecalith. Let's step under the microscope.

zhText: 在病理学家眼里，急性阑尾炎的本质，始终绕不开两个核心动作——“变质”和“渗出”。
enText: To a pathologist, acute appendicitis always revolves around two core processes: alteration and exudation.

zhText: 当管腔被堵死、腔内压力飙升，黏膜屏障在缺血和细菌的双重夹击下迅速坏死、破溃脱落——这种组织细胞的损伤，就是“变质”。
enText: Blocked and pressurized, the ischemic mucosa breaks down under bacterial attack—this cellular necrosis and ulceration is alteration.

zhText: 警报一响，血管立刻扩张充血，把血浆和成群的分叶核中性粒细胞挤出血管壁，穿过内皮间隙，弥漫冲向阑尾壁全层——这就是“渗出”。
enText: Alarmed vessels dilate, squeezing plasma and multi-lobed neutrophils through endothelial gaps to flood every wall layer—that is exudation.

zhText: 战火一路烧穿肌层，直达最外层的浆膜。请仔细看浆膜表面渗出的东西：它可不只是单纯的纤维素，而是纤维素与脓液的混合渗出物。
enText: The battle burns through the muscle to the outer serosa. Look closely: what oozes out is not pure fibrin, but a mix of fibrin and pus.

zhText: 在交织成网的纤维素丝之间，密密麻麻裹挟着大量变性坏死的中性粒细胞，也就是脓细胞——这种“纤维素性脓性渗出物”，才是阑尾表面灰黄色的真正来源！
enText: Tangled within the fibrin mesh are legions of degenerated neutrophils—pus cells. This fibrinous-purulent exudate is the true source of that yellow color!

zhText: 从暗红的单纯性、灰黄的化脓性，再到焦黑的坏疽性，这是急性阑尾炎最常见的经典演变路径——但请记住，它并不是每个患者都必须走完的固定流程。
enText: From dark-red simple, to grayish-yellow phlegmonous, to black gangrenous—this is the classic pathway, yet not a rigid sequence every patient must go through.

zhText: 如果战火还停留在早期的单纯性阶段，中性粒细胞主要聚集在黏膜和黏膜下层，更深处的平滑肌层里，只能零星见到散在的寥寥几个。
enText: In early simple appendicitis, neutrophils gather mostly in the mucosa and submucosa, with only a few scattered in the smooth muscle layer.

zhText: 可一旦化脓蔓延全层，肿胀压迫血管、甚至让阑尾系膜静脉里长出血栓，血液供应就会被彻底掐断——
enText: Once suppuration floods every layer, swelling and mesenteric venous thrombosis can cut off blood supply completely—

zhText: 失去血供的阑尾迅速发黑坏死，变成最凶险的坏疽性阑尾炎；脆弱的管壁随时可能穿孔，脓液涌入腹腔，引爆危及生命的弥漫性腹膜炎。
enText: Starved of blood, the appendix turns black and necrotic as gangrenous appendicitis; its fragile wall can perforate, triggering life-threatening peritonitis.

zhText: 可还没进手术室之前，医生怎么隔着肚皮判断它到了哪一步？答案首先是：靠典型的临床症状和仔细的体格检查。
enText: Before surgery, how do doctors tell its stage through the abdomen? First and foremost: classic clinical symptoms and a careful physical exam.

zhText: CT 是重要的辅助确诊工具，但并非所有患者都必须做；而在需要确诊或判断严重程度时，多层螺旋 CT 的诊断敏感度可达百分之九十三以上。
enText: CT is a vital diagnostic aid, though not mandatory for everyone; when needed, multi-slice CT reaches over 93% sensitivity.

zhText: 更厉害的是，CT 影像与病理变化高度一致：单纯性仅见管腔轻度增粗、脂肪间隙清晰；化脓性可见管壁厚实强化、周围絮状渗出；坏疽性甚至会出现强化管壁局部缺损与游离气体。
enText: Even better, CT mirrors pathology: mild thickening with clean fat in simple; thick wall enhancement and fat stranding in phlegmonous; focal wall defects and free gas in gangrenous.

zhText: 临床医生最关心的，就是你现在属于哪一型、有没有化脓、坏疽或穿孔——这直接决定了治疗紧迫性。一旦发展为蜂窝织炎性或坏疽性阑尾炎，必须尽早手术切除！
enText: What matters most clinically is the current subtype and perforation risk—directly dictating urgency. Both phlegmonous and gangrenous appendicitis require prompt surgical removal!

zhText: 聊到这儿，细心的你可能会问：教科书里炎症常说的“增生”去哪了？其实，只有当急性阑尾炎反复发作、拖成慢性阑尾炎时，修复性的“增生”才会真正登场。
enText: You might wonder: where is the "proliferation" of inflammation? Only when recurrent acute episodes turn into chronic appendicitis does reparative proliferation appear.

zhText: 镜下可见阑尾壁明显纤维化、伴随淋巴细胞等慢性炎细胞浸润。慢性阑尾炎的手术时机核心原则是：一旦确诊，通常建议在症状缓解期择期切除；若正处于急性发作期，则视情况急诊手术。
enText: Microscopy shows wall fibrosis and chronic inflammatory infiltration. Core surgical rule: once diagnosed, elective resection in remission is usually advised; during acute flare-ups, emergency surgery as indicated.

zhText: 从粉白到暗红、灰黄再到焦黑，这根“小香肠”的每一次变色，都是身体发出的求救信号。面对转移性右下腹痛、高热与腹部拒按，别硬扛、别乱吃止痛药，尽早就医！
enText: From pink to dark red, yellow, and black, every color shift is an SOS. Facing migratory right lower abdominal pain, fever, and guarding, never tough it out—seek prompt care!
